faq.question: Do you manufacture products yourselves?
faq.answer: No. We support supplier research, evaluation, and launch readiness. Manufacturing remains with the selected supplier.

faq.question: Can you source only within specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes. We define category boundaries, constraints, and differentiation needs before outreach begins.

faq.question: How do you evaluate suppliers?
faq.answer: We compare cost, MOQ, lead times, communication quality, and product fit against your brief rather than selecting on price alone.

faq.question: Does sourcing include compliance certification?
faq.answer: We identify likely documentation and compliance considerations for the product type. Formal testing or certification is handled through qualified providers when required. We do not guarantee marketplace approval.

faq.question: How does sourcing connect to Amazon launch?
faq.answer: Approved products hand off into catalog setup, listing content, creative, and advertising planning so sourcing does not end at sample approval.

faq.question: Is this suitable for first-time Amazon sellers?
faq.answer: Yes, when there is a clear brief and budget for sampling. We set expectations on timelines and decision criteria during the free audit.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support for launches?
faq.answer: We support launch and catalog work across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Supplier regions and compliance needs vary by product and market; scope is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a product brief, supplier shortlist, sample evaluation, then launch handoff.
